features.feature: Key/value abbreviations, precedence and unlisted entries
features.assertions: inline_images_dictionary_audit explicitly tests W/Width and I/Interpolate both orders, ignored SMask, Indexed-family I. Eight-image corpus comparison additionally requires nonwhite first image and all equal; it alone is not universal all-key proof.

features.assertions: inline_images tests computed unfiltered grid with embedded EI; stated length and wrong-length policy; filter EOD including ASCII85 encoded EI, runlength literal EI, JPEG thumbnail EOI, fax pattern and buffer cut. Exact resumed suffix/marker drawings and decoded samples are independent expected outputs.
features.verdict: Supported sampled valid extents; malformed fallback and 16MiB window are policy. Prior fax RTC claim qualification T06 still applies.

features.feature: Separator and raw binary sample preservation
features.assertions: New inline_images_residual_audit::inline_data_keeps_whitespace_and_delimiter_samples_after_one_separator checks all six Table1 separators against nine leading sample bytes, except CR+LF pair (53 cases). Exact sample bytes and resume suffix asserted.
features.verdict: PASS. Does not treat sample percent as comment or discard leading whitespace.
features.residual: ADR0019 treats CRLF as one EOL. Whether this consumes a valid LF sample after a one-byte CR separator is an interpretation question: §8.9.7 says single whitespace character/next byte, §7.2.3 says CRLF one EOL. No disputed normative failing assertion promoted.

features.assertions: Existing literal RGB quadrants plus post-image marker; named/raw-byte resources; mask true withoutCS red/transparent samples; DefaultGray both named equivalent and differing ordinary gray control; LZW literal sample decoder and EOD; ASCII85 delimiter immediately afterID decoded literal sample. Additional public pixel tests verify reserved G/DeviceGray names ignore same-named resources while Custom resolves the same CalGray space, and Indexed I/RGB expansion renders both literal red/blue palette entries.
features.verdict: Meaningful sampled consumer controls. No exhaustive defaultRGB/CMYK shadow-name matrix.

features.evidence: 4096byte maximum is SHOULD advice, not mandatory reader refusal. PDF2 L required on producer; forbidden JPX/JBIG2/Crypt and real dimensions are malformed inputs, not valid-feature nonimplementation. Current integer_entry rounds nearest; ledger still says truncation.
features.verdict: Document stale recovery-policy description separately, not valid-input rendering defect.
